core_ruling: P0 survives only after subtraction: logical information obligations must not be reified into mandatory sidecars/profiles/caches; the first candidate is cacheless serial bounded LONG_SHARDED and synthesis stops at the first candidate that passes all pre-frozen boundaries.
baseline_keep: logical separation of physical missingness, semantic response state, and routing
transactional content-addressed publication plus explicit active-root CAS
one representation-neutral integration runner plus independent oracle
delete_from_baseline: separate completeness index when exhaustive root-listed shards suffice
adaptive encoding policy engine before standard tuning fails
parallel scheduler before serial bounded wall-time failure
steady-state retained full rollback copy absent higher authority

organization_law.LONG_SHARDED: wins immediately if cacheless serial bounded implementation passes all semantic/integrity/boundedness/storage/pre-frozen practical runtime/maintainability boundaries
organization_law.QUESTION_BLOCKED_LONG: admissible only when LONG_SHARDED fails a pre-frozen question-projection/read-amplification boundary and blocking by native question fixes that boundary while preserving the identical event schema, cacheless open-world path, and every other boundary
organization_law.HYBRID_DENSE_PLUS_EXPLICIT: admissible only when lower-risk organizations still fail a pre-frozen boundary attributable to repeated event-row/coordinate overhead, exact R02-style geometry/grain certificates cover every dense block, explicit escape is total, and the hybrid passes the no-cache full oracle without source-family semantic branching

benchmark_law: Freeze absolute hard/preferred resource and practical runtime boundaries before candidate results. Crossing fail-to-pass can justify complexity; speed or compression beyond a passing boundary earns no architectural credit. No weighted score or relative percentage threshold selects the winner.
one_copy_migration: One active serving root. One non-serving shadow may coexist only during a bounded court. Promotion atomically removes old serving authority. No automatic fallback. No steady-state full rollback duplicate absent higher authority; rollback otherwise reconstructs/restores and freshly verifies.
packaging_remediation: Round-1 R06 common-package nonconformance is remediated by this complete Round-2 package without rerunning Round-1 reconnaissance.
